final: WITH large_orders AS (SELECT o.order_id, o.account_id, o.amount, d.A3 as region FROM `order` o JOIN account a ON o.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE o.amount > 2802), group_averages AS (SELECT account_id, region, AVG(amount) as group_avg FROM large_orders GROUP BY account_id, region), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(group_avg) as overall_figure FROM group_averages) SELECT g.account_id, g.region, g.group_avg, g.group_avg - o.overall_figure as difference FROM group_averages g CROSS JOIN overall_avg o ORDER BY difference DESC LIMIT 10
